title: H7 fix round 4: rerun ids are validated as test node ids (no leading dash, a .py path or ::) before becoming argv, and the rerun uses the worktree's own runner via uv run --project as tests-green.sh does, converting node ids to unittest form when needed (review T-0420)
spec:
STEP 0: the worktree must contain b9c2972, fb696ce, 4a605cc, a398092 and 95a5553 (T-0364, T-0412, T-0414, T-0418) in git log; never drop or amend them.
Review T-0420 on T-0418, both findings to address:
1. (high) orchestrator/daemon.py:153 _test_ids extracts whitespace-free tokens from untrusted failure text and this text now reaches subprocess.run(runner, ..., *ids); a crafted line such as --rootdir=/ becomes a runner argument. Fix: validate each id with one strict pattern before use: it must match a path ending in .py optionally followed by ::name segments (letters, digits, underscore, dots, brackets for parametrised ids), or a dotted module.Class.test name; anything starting with a dash, containing whitespace, shell metacharacters or path traversal (..) is dropped and counted in resume_hint.rejected_ids. Test: tests/test_daemon.py::test_rerun_rejects_argument_like_ids (a failure line with --rootdir=/ and ../x.py::t yields no rerun argv for those, they are recorded as rejected).
2. (med) orchestrator/daemon.py:123 _flaky_rerun_command chooses pytest vs unittest with importlib.util.find_spec against the daemon's interpreter, while the gate resolved the runner inside the worktree via uv run --project .; when they diverge the rerun gets pytest node ids but runs python -m unittest with them and always errors, so a flaky test is misclassified as code_defect forever. Fix: build the rerun exactly as tests-green.sh does for the worktree: uv run --project <worktree> python -c "import pytest" decides; with pytest use uv run --project <worktree> pytest -q -x <ids>; without it convert each node id path/to/test_x.py::Class::name (or ::name) into the unittest dotted form (path.to.test_x.Class.name) and run uv run --project <worktree> python -m unittest <dotted ids>; ids that cannot be converted are treated as not rerunnable (kind stays unknown, recorded). Tests: tests/test_daemon.py::test_rerun_runner_resolved_in_worktree_not_daemon_interpreter (find_spec in the daemon says pytest, the worktree probe says no: unittest form is used), ::test_node_id_to_unittest_conversion.
Keep every T-0364 lineage test green (adapt test_flaky_rerun_then_escalate and test_flaky_rerun_max_two_reruns_twice_then_escalates only where the argv shape changes, keeping their assertions on ids, cwd and timeout). Run .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh from the worktree root until it exits 0, then git add -A and git commit with the task id; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: git log --oneline in the worktree shows 95a5553, a398092, 4a605cc, fb696ce and b9c2972 below your commit
grep shows the rerun argv is built only from validated ids and the runner probe runs inside the worktree via uv run --project
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree
